polymod.name: TSPML sample PML mod
polymod.author: TSPML
polymod.description: A PML-format mod served by the portal itself, so the PML compatibility adapter has a known-good end-to-end target: the CDN walk (this file was reached from ../manifest.json), the PolyModLoader import rewrite, lifecycle hooks, a real keybind, and a mixin that must be refused BY NAME while the mod keeps running.
